candidate.answerReason: The text messages cost $5, and the 30 excess minutes cost $3. Adding the $20 monthly charge gives $28, agreeing with D.

methods.label: Add the three charges
methods.explanation:
Only the time beyond \(30\) hours incurs the extra minute charge. Michelle's excess time is
\[
30.5-30=0.5\text{ hour}=30\text{ minutes}.
\]
Her \(100\) text messages cost \(100\times\$0.05=\$5\), and the excess calls cost \(30\times\$0.10=\$3\). Adding these to the monthly charge gives
\[
\$20+\$5+\$3=\boxed{\$28.00}.
\]
The answer is choice \(\boxed{\text{D}}\).
